# CANDIDATE: VWAP_RIBBON_PULLBACK_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

When price pulls back to VWAP during a strong ribbon-aligned uptrend, the confluence of dynamic support (VWAP) and trend bias (ribbon alignment) offers a high-probability long entry. This setup captures mean-reversion within a trending environment, adding volume confirmation to filter false signals.

## Mechanism

Entry rule: In an uptrend defined by ribbon (EMA8 > EMA21 > EMA55) and price above VWAP, wait for price to touch or cross VWAP from above with a bullish candle (close > open) and volume > 1.5x the average volume of the last 20 bars; enter long at the close of that bar.  
Exit shape: Initial stop at the recent swing low (structure stop) or 0.5% below entry; target at 1.5R or trail using a chandelier exit (ATR*3) after 1R profit.  
Regime hint: Best in low-moderate VIX (<20) and during regular trading hours (post-open 30 min to pre-close 30 min) when ribbon trend is clear; avoid choppy markets where ribbon is flat or intertwined.
